_doc: Cada movimiento requiere: id (unico), name, type, power, accuracy, pp, category (physical/special/status). "effect" es un objeto con type y params segun el tipo. Tipos: none, status, status_chance, fixed_damage, psywave, ohko, multi_hit, stat_stage, stat_stage_chance, stat_stage_self, drain, heal, heal_weather, recoil, crash, recoil_crash, flinch_chance, screen, weather, trap, leech_seed, protect, bide, etc. Para fixed_damage usar amount: "level"|"half_hp"|numero. Para multi_hit usar min y max. Para stat_stage usar target, stat, stages.
